title: Name the standing admission that matches each pack's source
summary: The frozen flat pilot section of docs/TRAINING.md told contributors to freeze the input declaration from the 29 September 128-robot admission, and SPARK.md named that declaration as current. PR 65 changed env.py and env_config.py, so a pack from current main fails the admission check with that record. Both guides now name the admission by the source it matches: the four prepared packages hold source 620d9aa9 and keep the 29 September admission, and a pack from current main takes the 10 October 128-robot admission under /srv/cupi/hexapod/inputs/replicas_20261010_001. The pilot's budget, seeds, arms and gates stay as they were.
next: Prepare new flat pilot packs from main with the 10 October declaration. A later physics change needs a new matching admission and a new line in these two guides.
reason: A documentation correction establishes no native result or accepted capability.
